metadata.question: Did the turbidity of the Beaufort Sea (specifically at 69.954148, -136.325766) increase between June 14, 2012, and July 5, 2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point at 69.954148, -136.325766 (Beaufort Sea, Arctic) - Dates: June 14, 2012 and July 5, 2012 - Collection: Landsat for 2012 (Landsat 7 ETM+ or Landsat 5 TM available) - Turbidity indicator: Use water turbidity bands or calculate from visible bands (Red/Green ratio is common for turbidity) 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds since we want to measure water turbidity accurately - This is Arctic summer, so should have images, but cloud cover can be high - Need to ensure we're looking at water pixels 3. Logic: - Get turbidity values for both dates - Compare: if July > June, answer A (increased); if July <= June, answer B - Handle cases: C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels after masking), C3 (invalid calculations) - For turbidity, I'll use a simple band ratio or suspended matter index ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-136.325766, 69.954148]); const date1 = '2012-06-14'; const date2 = '2012-07-05'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Try Landsat 7 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June 14 images: ${size1}, July 5 images: ${size2}`); // Try Landsat 5 as fallback if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); const size1_l5 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2_l5 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 5 - June 14: ${size1_l5}, July 5: ${size2_l5}`); if (size1_l5 === 0 || size2_l5 === 0) { console.log('No images found for one or both dates'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing - Calculate turbidity using Red/Green ratio function addTurbidity(image) { const red = image.select('SR_B3').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const green = image.select('SR_B2').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const turbidity = red.divide(green).rename('turbidity'); return image.addBands(turbidity); } function maskClouds(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask); } const img1 = col1.map(maskClouds).map(addTurbidity).first(); const img2 = col2.map(maskClouds).map(addTurbidity).first(); // Check valid pixels const buffer = point.buffer(1000); const count1 = await img1.select('turbidity').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('turbidity').getInfo(); const count2 = await img2.select('turbidity').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('turbidity').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels - June 14: ${count1}, July 5: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculate turbidity values const turb1 = await img1.select('turbidity').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('turbidity').getInfo(); const turb2 = await img2.select('turbidity').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('turbidity').getInfo(); console.log(`Turbidity - June 14: ${turb1}, July 5: ${turb2}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (turb1 === null || turb2 === null || isNaN(turb1) || isNaN(turb2)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid turbidity values'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (turb1 < 0 || turb2 < 0 || turb1 > 10 || turb2 > 10) { console.log('Invalid turbidity range detected'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Change: ${((turb2 - turb1) / turb1 * 100).toFixed(2)}%`); if (turb2 > turb1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
